messages:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock Q3 scope for the Optimize toolkit around promptset/eval regression detection + batching/caching recommendations. Who's in for a 30m tomorrow?
Miguel (Eng): in for 30. main concerns: infra for promptset storage + CI hooks.
Sasha (ML): +1. want clear metrics for what counts as a regression (quality vs latency vs cost).
Priya (Product Ops): customers asking specifically for: 1) auto-alerts on prompt regressions, 2) prescriptive batching/caching configs, 3) easy onboarding for their eval sets.
Evan (SRE): need SLA/ops constraints. If we auto-recommend batching we must guarantee safe defaults — no unexpected latency spikes.
Jordan (Design): can do a compact UX flow: "Evaluate -> Alert -> Apply Recommendation". will prototype a minimal banner + modal.
Ava (PM): Proposed MVP (shippable in 8w):
- Promptset runner + baseline store (upload & version prompt sets)
- Regression detector that runs nightly evaluations and flags >2% quality drop on key metrics
- Recommendations UI for batching/caching with 3 preset profiles (conservative/cost/perf)
- Integration point for CI to block deploys on critical regressions
Sasha (ML): For the regression rule, suggest: 
```
metric: perplexity | rouge | embed-sim
baseline_window: last_5_runs
alert_if: metric_drop >= 2% AND p_value < 0.05
severity: warn/critical
```
Miguel (Eng): backend work estimate: 3w infra (storage + scheduled eval runner) + 3w callbacks/UI API + 2w recommendations engine = 8w. Can parallelize with Jordan/Sasha.
Priya (Product Ops): Customer ask prioritization: AcmeHealth (HIPAA) needs private promptset support, Shoply wants cost-tuning recommendations asap. Both asked to be beta partners.
Evan (SRE): Note: nightly evals at scale will spike GPU usage. Need autoscaling + throttle. Suggest a soft-quota per-customer for evals.
Ava (PM): Launch criteria proposal (must meet all):
- Regression detection accuracy > 90% on historical testcases (no more than 1 false positive per 100 alerts)
- Recommendations reduce per-token cost by >= 10% for cost profile on our testbench
- UX flows validated with 2 beta customers (AcmeHealth, Shoply)
- Docs + SDK examples for running promptsets in CI
Jordan (Design): UX acceptance: banner + single modal to apply recommendation in <= 2 clicks. Provide copy + screenshot for docs.
Sasha (ML): We should include a small canonical promptset for internal regressions so we don't depend only on customer-provided sets. I can curate 30 prompts.
Miguel (Eng): question on rollout: canary roadmap? prefer canary by customer tier + region.
Ava (PM): yes — rollout plan: internal -> beta partners -> 10% hosted -> 50% -> GA. fallback policy: auto-disable recommendations if latency > target for 3 consecutive runs.
Evan (SRE): ci-bot will enforce canary guardrails.
ci-bot: scheduled job created: optimize-evals-nightly-run @ 02:00 UTC, target concurrency 20, notify #product on failures.
Priya (Product Ops): Tradeoffs to note: private promptset support adds ~2w ops work for VPC keys/KMS integration. Recommend deferring to Dedicated/Private track unless customer beta is critical.
Ava (PM): Decision call: MVP scope = promptset runner + regression alerts + recommendations UI + CI hook. Defer full private promptset support to next quarter unless AcmeHealth signs immediate beta.
Sasha (ML): OK. I'll deliver regression model + canonical promptset by week 3.
Miguel (Eng): I'll schedule infra sprints and allocate 2 engineers. Creating a GH epic now.
Jordan (Design): I'll drop a high-fidelity modal and 2 microcopy variants by EOD Friday.
Priya (Product Ops): I'll reach out to AcmeHealth & Shoply to confirm beta details and success criteria.
Evan (SRE): I'll add autoscaling playbook and quota defaults to the runbook.
Ava (PM): Action items summarized: 
- Sasha: regression model + canonical promptset (wk3)
- Miguel: infra + APIs epic (kickoff today)
- Jordan: UX modal + copy (Fri)
- Priya: customer beta outreach (this week)
- Evan: runbook + autoscaling throttles (wk2)
We reconvene next Tue 10am to check progress.
Miguel (Eng): noted. setting calendar.
Priya (Product Ops): added tasks to the roadmap board.
Ava (PM): thanks all — goal: reduce regression time-to-detect < 24h and make batching recs non-disruptive. :rocket:
ci-bot: job optimize-evals-nightly-run completed: first smoke scheduled (no failures yet).
